newsitem.title: USA: Wheels Sports buys Diamond Sports Group.
newsitem.headline: Wheels Sports buys Diamond Sports Group.

text.p: Wheels Sports Group Inc said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire privately-held Diamond Sports Group for 480,000 common shares.

Diamond Sports Group is a motorsports-related apparel, souvenir and hospitality management company. Wheels Sports Group designs, markets and distributes sports trading cards, primarily featuring figures from automobile racing.
Wheels Sports said the deal is subject to the completion of due diligence and other customary closing conditions.
Wheels shares rose 5/8 to 8-1/8 in mid-afternoon activity.
